_note: A relative `types` entry (`./worker-configuration.d.ts`) next to the user's tsconfig still fails under svelte-check: tsgo resolves `types` against the root config it compiles, which is svelte-check's overlay in `.svelte-check/`. svelte-check --tsgo 4.7.7 reports the resulting file-less TS2688 on the project tsconfig at 1:1, quoting the entry as written, and so do we.
